svg.title: O2C aging, collections, cashflow and ECL — editable design source
svg.desc: Five screens. All values are unavailable states, no fabricated financial records. Planned interface, with runtime aging boundary alignment required.

g.text: Understand exposure by due-date bucket, then inspect each customer and invoice.
Unavailable until company access is configured
Due in the future = Not yet due. Due today to 30 days = 0–30. Boundaries never overlap.
Connect customer accounts and posted invoice allocations to calculate aging.
Drill-down: bucket → customer account → invoice → allocations and supporting evidence.
Review evidence, payment promises and proposed follow-ups in one place.
Unavailable until company access is configured
Select an account to load source evidence.
Payment promise: date and amount must be sourced.
A draft becomes available after a verified
customer and authorized context are selected.
Account history and outbound records remain separate from financial ledger posting.
Review a governed direct-method forecast with traceable receipts and payments.
Unavailable until company access is configured
No synthetic forecast, default collection assumptions or invented opening cash.
Inspect preserved measurement runs, exposure lineage and independent approval.
Unavailable until company access is configured
No default loss rates are applied.
A ledger write requires authorized review and recorded confirmation.
Future due dates remain Not yet due.
